B-ROLL CANDIDATE EVALUATED AND REJECTED. Checked both plausible Pexels clips: Generic_Frog_Eating_Firefly_01.mp4 has a real tongue/lunge-strike action but at a daylight pond surface with lily pads (wrong lighting, wrong habitat, wrong predation mechanic -- an aquatic surface-lunge, not a stationary leaf-perch tongue-flick) -- visually and behaviorally inconsistent with this beat's night cloud-forest ambush description. Generic_Frog_On_Leaves_At_Night_04.mp4 has the right night/leaf mood but the frog 'remains still' the entire clip -- zero strike action, so it doesn't cover the specific action described ('quick tongue-flick strike'). Neither genuinely matches the described action; forcing either in would be a bad substitution per the skill's own guidance. Generated instead, keeping the same individual as the rest of the scene for identity continuity.
